_meta.placement: Draw over the floor cell, after the floor layer. Frames play in index order and loop: the last runs into the first, so there is no reverse leg and no hold frame.
_meta.note: GRID VERIFIED by scripts/build_sprite_reference.mjs against the PNG header (128x64 / 32 = 4x2, 8 frames, no remainder). Generated from common/dungeon_portals.json — do not hand-edit; re-run the script instead. Frame names are the exporter's own, kept verbatim so a re-export cannot drift from the reference.
